commands.author: qingminglong

target.title: fix(memory): qmd search fails when logs prefix results
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where qmd-backed memory search could report invalid JSON when qmd writes bracketed log lines such as `[INFO]` before the actual result array.

## Why This Change Was Made

The noisy stdout parser now scans complete top-level qmd result arrays in one pass, skips bracketed log prefixes and malformed bracket fragments, and preserves nested JSON inside valid qmd results. The change stays inside the memory-host qmd parser and adds focused parser and memory-core manager coverage for the noisy stdout path.

## User Impact

Memory search can tolerate common qmd/native stdout prefixes and still return matching results instead of failing the lookup. Malformed log fragments before the result array no longer amplify parsing into repeated suffix scans.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: qmd stdout with bracketed log prefixes or malformed bracket fragments before the result array is skipped, while nested arrays inside valid qmd result objects are preserved until the enclosing top-level result array is parsed.
- Current head: `95bbf174e7640154fd54377f1c94b1f3a60c5da1`.
- Focused tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/qmd-query-parser.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/memory/qmd-manager.test.ts -- -t "bracketed stdout log prefixes|unmatched bracket fragments|quoted malformed log fragments|nested unknown array fields|nested array fields before the outer result array"` passed: 4 parser regression cases and 1 memory-core manager case passed.
- OpenClaw runtime proof: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` created a temporary qmd-compatible command, then called `QmdMemoryManager.create(..., mode: "status")` and `manager.search("router glacier backup")`. The manager spawned `qmd` args `["query","router glacier backup","--json","-n","4","-c","workspace-main"]`; stdout began with `[INFO] qmd native stdout ready`; `manager.search` returned `[{"path":"notes/welcome.md","startLine":2,"endLine":2,"score":0.93,"snippet":"@@ -2,1\nrouter glacier backup","source":"memory"}]`.
- qmd CLI availability probe: `npx -y @tobilu/qmd@2.5.3 --help` printed the qmd help/usage successfully. The local PATH still has no persistent `qmd` command, so the current runtime transcript uses the OpenClaw qmd child-process boundary with a temporary qmd-compatible command rather than a machine-local qmd index.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local` passed with `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`.
- Duplicate check: live GitHub search found no matching open PRs or issues for `qmd query JSON noisy stdout`, `qmd log prefixes`, or `qmd-query-parser`.
